Clears priority_plan_ref from the specified backlog item.

  Remove backlog item from plan
  zqk pplan remove PRI-123 BLI-456
  Alternative positional syntax
  zqk pplan PRI-123 remove BLI-456

Usage:
  zqk object pplan remove [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
